nothing_found: I found nothing for "{query}" in your libraries.
unknown_handle: I can only send a book from your last search. Search for it again.
no_kindle_named: You don't have a Kindle set up in Kavita. {admin} can add one.
no_kindle_unnamed: You don't have a Kindle set up in Kavita. Your Kavita admin can add one.
which_kindle: You have several Kindles: {list}. Which one? (call send_to_kindle with kindle)
bad_format: "{title}" is a {format} file; a Kindle only takes EPUB or PDF.
email_off: Sending to a Kindle is switched off in Kavita right now. {tell}
confirm: Send "{title}" ({format}, {size}) to your Kindle "{device}"? ✅ to confirm, ❌ to cancel.
sent: Sent. It will be on your Kindle in a few minutes.
kavita_unreachable: Kavita isn't answering, try again in a few minutes.
no_elicitation: This chat cannot ask you to confirm, so nothing was sent.
